lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Quiet WarrantNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56ARREST AT MERRIPIT HOUSE: THE BASKERVILLE CASEThe arrest is made on the Tuesday, by daylight, without a shot. The hound is never seen. A sergeant finds it on the Thursday, in a pit behind the barn, with a bullet in its head, where the man who bred it has put it out of the way of the evidence. The trial is dull and conclusive. Sir Henry sails for Canada in the autumn, with a cheerful letter and a new set of boots, and says that he will return in the spring. You have not been needed, and the thing has been done by the law. You are not sure that you were meant to be pleased. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
